features: Android 14 smart control panel (4-wire hybrid) with built-in 2MP camera
4 GB RAM + 16 GB ROM, installable APK apps
built-in 2MP camera, 75-degree FOV, H.264, main/sub 1080p streams, RTSP
video intercom, video monitoring and wireless alarm hub
Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth BR/EDR/BLE, Zigbee (802.15.4), sub-GHz 868 MHz
light / temperature / humidity sensors, proximity auto-wake
release_notes: The Dahua SCP3024B-CBZ is a 4-wire hybrid Android 14 smart control panel with a 7-inch touchscreen and a built-in 2MP camera (75-degree FOV, H.264, RTSP). It combines video intercom, video monitoring and a wireless alarm hub (Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Zigbee/sub-GHz). The camera-less SCP3024A-B panel is a separate SKU. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Android smart control panel with built-in camera; add the RTSP stream via Generic Camera.
